description: Parameters that indicate a write-capable tool was designed with a brake. Used for the 'destructive without guardrails' classifier AND for the registered counter-measure in protocol/PROTOCOL.md section 4 — the figure that cuts against the publisher's thesis.
sourceNotes: Absence of all of these is not proof of a missing guardrail; a server may confirm out of band, or make the operation idempotent server-side without saying so. This is why the classifier is tri-state.
